entries.text: JooqSessionRepository.takeover invokes AuditedTransactionBoundary.inTransaction(actor, action, work), never the correlationRunId overload. The database audit trigger therefore receives no app.correlation_run_id and PA-2's required non-null shared takeover correlation must fail. The frozen contract assigns this production behavior to B1-3, while this dispatch permits only B1-10 HTTP/integration harness and tests. Please decide whether to expand scope for the missing correlation propagation or revise/supersede the acceptance requirement.
